name: influencer-brief
description:
Produces a completed creator/influencer brief with brand context, campaign
goal, content guidance, deliverables, and dos/don'ts for influencer
marketing partnerships. Use when the user asks to create an influencer
brief, plan a creator collaboration, write guidelines for sponsored content,
or structure an influencer marketing partnership.
Do NOT use for PR media pitches (use pr-pitch), social media strategy
(use social-media-strategy), or paid ad copy written in-house (use
paid-ad-copy).
